title: Tip from Angela - When Life Gives You Lemons
summary: Motivational, non-technical talk about handling unfair setbacks by focusing on what you can control.

concepts.heading: Key takeaway
points: The instructor recounts a school disappointment and the advice she received afterwards: some things are outside your control (other people's decisions), while your interpretation of events and your response are yours to set.
Applied to learning to code: unfair obstacles will happen, so keep working and building. Steady effort is presented as the best answer to setbacks.
No technical content in this lecture.
